'''''UFC 333: Volkanovski vs. Evloev''''' is an upcoming mixed martial arts event produced by the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] that is scheduled to take place on October 24, 2026, at the [[Etihad Arena]] in [[Abu Dhabi]], United Arab Emirates.<ref name="AbuDhabi">{{Cite web|url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/ufc/article/ufc-returning-to-abu-dhabi-for-ufc-333-in-october/|title=UFC returning to Abu Dhabi for UFC 333 in October|publisher=sportsnet.ca|author=Staff|date=2026-07-25|access-date=2026-07-26}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/07/25/ufc-333-abu-dhabi-october-24-fight-card-announcement-etihad-arena-numbered-event/91047400007/|title=UFC announces return to Abu Dhabi for UFC 333 on Oct. 24|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Farah Hannoun|date=2026-07-25|access-date=2026-07-26}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thenationalnews.com/sport/combat-sports/2026/07/25/ufc-333-heading-to-abu-dhabi-as-mma-giants-confirm-october-return-to-etihad-arena/|title=UFC 333 heading to Abu Dhabi as MMA giants confirm October return to Etihad Arena|publisher=thenationalnews.com|author=Andy Lewis|date=2026-07-25|access-date=2026-07-26}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://whatson.ae/2026/07/ufc-333-is-coming-to-abu-dhabi-this-october/|title=Just announced: UFC 333 is coming to Abu Dhabi this October|publisher=whatson.ae|author=Sammi Barnard|date=2026-07-25|access-date=2026-07-26}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://middleeasy.com/mma-news/ufc-333-abu-dhabi-oct-24-etihad-arena/|title=UFC 333 lands in Abu Dhabi on Oct. 24 as Etihad Arena gets another numbered event|publisher=middleeasy.com|author=Jake Blend|date=2026-07-25|access-date=2026-07-26}}</ref>

==Background==
The event will mark the promotion's 24th visit to Abu Dhabi and its first since [[UFC Fight Night: Ankalaev vs. Guskov]] in July 2026. It will also be the eleventh numbered event held in the city, following [[UFC 321]] in October 2025.<ref name="AbuDhabi"/>

A [[UFC Featherweight Championship]] bout between reigning two-time champion [[Alexander Volkanovski]] and undefeated contender [[Movsar Evloev]] is scheduled to headline the event.<ref name="volkmovsar">{{Cite web|url=https://www.telecomasia.net/news/mma/volkanovski-evloev-title-fight-ufc-333/|title=Volkanovski vs Evloev title fight set for October 24 at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi|publisher=telecomasia.net|author=Anastasiia Dudkina|date=2026-07-25|access-date=2026-07-29}}</ref>

A [[UFC Bantamweight Championship]] trilogy bout between reigning two-time champion [[Petr Yan]] and former champion [[Merab Dvalishvili]] will take place as the co-main event.<ref name="yanmerab3">{{Cite web|url=https://bloodyelbow.com/2026/08/09/alexander-volkanovski-and-petr-yan-are-reportedly-set-to-defend-their-ufc-belts-at-ufc-333/|title=Alexander Volkanovski and Petr Yan are reportedly set to defend their UFC belts at UFC 333|publisher=bloodyelbow.com|author=Jordan Ellis|date=2026-08-09|access-date=2026-08-10}}</ref> The pair first met in March 2023 at [[UFC Fight Night: Yan vs. Dvalishvili]], where Dvalishvili defeated Yan via unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web|title=UFC Las Vegas: Merab Dvalishvili dominates ex-champ Petr Yan in standout performance|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2023/03/11/ufc-las-vegas-petr-yan-vs-merab-dvalishvili/|date=2023-03-11|access-date=2026-08-10|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Jay Anderson}}</ref> Their second meeting took place in December 2025 at [[UFC 323]], where Yan defeated Dvalishvili to reclaim the bantamweight title, ending the latter's 14-fight winning streak at the time.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2025/12/07/ufc-323-petr-yan-dethrones-merab-dvalishvili-in-rematch/|title=UFC 323: Petr Yan Dethrones Merab Dvalishvili in Rematch|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Jay Anderson|date=2025-12-07|access-date=2026-08-10}}</ref>

A featherweight bout between [[Arnold Allen]] and [[Aaron Pico]] was scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/two-massive-title-fights-ufc-333/|title=Two massive title fights headline UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi|publisher=heavy.com|author=Marcel Dorff|date=2026-08-15|access-date=2026-09-18}}</ref> However, Allen withdrew due to an injury and was replaced by [[Losene Keita]].<ref name="Keita">{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/09/18/ufc-333-losene-keita-vs-aaron-pico-abu-dhabi/91813375007/|title=Losene Keita steps into UFC 333 banger vs. Aaron Pico|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-09-18|access-date=2026-09-18}}</ref>
